title: 4 morning habits that actually stick
hook: Four morning habits that actually stick.

points.label: 1. Same wake time
points.say: One. Wake up at the same time, even on weekends. Your body clock cannot learn a schedule that changes every day.

points.label: 2. Light before phone
points.say: Two. Get light before you get your phone. Two minutes outside does more for your energy than scrolling ever will.

points.label: 3. One glass of water
points.say: Three. Drink one glass of water before coffee. You wake up dehydrated, and caffeine on empty makes the crash worse.

points.label: 4. Decide the night before
points.say: Four. Decide the night before. One task, written down, so the morning is execution and not negotiation.

outro: Pick one. Give it a week before you add another.
caption:
Four morning habits that actually stick — and the reason each one works.

Most routines fail because they change five things at once. Pick one, give it a week, then add the next.

Which one are you starting with?
